# voipms_time_conditions (Data Source)

Lists time conditions (`getTimeConditions`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_time_conditions" "all" {}

output "time_condition_names" {
  value = [for c in data.voipms_time_conditions.all.time_conditions : c.name]
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`time_conditions`).
- `time_conditions` (Attributes List) Time conditions on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_conditions))

<a id="nestedatt--time_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_conditions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Time condition id.
- `name` (String) Time condition name.
- `route` (String) DID routing value (`tc:{id}`). Use this for `voipms_did` `routing` / failover.
- `routing_match` (String) Where the call goes inside any of the windows.
- `routing_nomatch` (String) Where the call goes outside every window.
- `windows` (Attributes List) Periods the condition matches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--time_conditions--windows))

<a id="nestedatt--time_conditions--windows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `time_conditions.windows`

Read-Only:

- `end_day` (String) Last weekday of the range, inclusive.
- `end_hour` (Number) Hour the window closes.
- `end_minute` (Number) Minute the window closes.
- `start_day` (String) First weekday of the range.
- `start_hour` (Number) Hour the window opens.
- `start_minute` (Number) Minute the window opens.
